extraction_notes: 5 pages, all clearly legible; text dump was empty so all values read from images. Page 1: methodology table (commissioner 'עיתון ישראל היום בע"מ', pollster 'קאנטר ישראל', fieldwork 2 Sept 15:40 – 3 Sept 08:30 [year 2026 from report header 3/09/2026], internet panel, random sampling, initial sample 550 ('גודל המדגם ההתחלתי') vs 2,349 invited ('מס' האנשים שהתבקשו להשתתף') – I recorded initial_sample = 2349 (number asked) per spec definition, respondents = 555, response rate 24%, 1,794 refused (76%), margin ±4.2%). Oddity: 'גודל המדגם ההתחלתי' = 550 is smaller than actual respondents 555 – apparently the target sample size, not the initial sample. Pages 2-4: three seat tables (current state + two merger scenarios), each sums to 120. Percent columns are explicitly raw ('נתונים גולמיים'); no undecided/other/blank rows – pcts of all parties incl. sub-threshold sum to 100%, so undecided/other/blank left null. Page 5: two non-vote-intention questions (unity-government support, party-vs-bloc preference) – ignored per spec.
